reviews.comment: Does give some mom vibes ngl, she cares about your performance. Make sure to attend class (5%) and put in the work. She gives great feedback and getting a 100 from the rubric after submitting rough drafts is not that hard. More of a busy work class. She even awards extra credit if you write something creative.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a very sweet lady and she is always there to help her students. There is a good amount of work but as long as you stay on top of it and go to class you should be fine.

Prof Nair is amazing and always advocated for her students & is extremely understanding. She was always kind and accessible despite personal struggles. Defiantly attend each class, bc she often extends deadlines and adjusts rules. there are 3 writing projects, (one group) and a group presentation. Easy class if you put in the effort.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you need this course, take her! She is incredibly understanding and wants students to succeed. Online reading for homework with discussions during class. A few assigned-group group-projects w/ short presentations, all very laid back. She offers points back with corrections.

She is AWESOME. Amazing Feedback & actually cares about her students. 3 major projects. That's it. Gives opportunities to make up grades. Follow her feedback, and you will do just fine. She does get passionate and rambles a little in class, but makes really interesting points. She is very sweet and completely approachable. One of my easiest As.

Mrs.Nair is a great professor! She's a pretty easy grader and lets you redo all major writing assignments for a 90. She is very serious about AI and runs everything through multiple AI detectors; however does not report to Honor Council. Announced that next semester would have every assignment be in class and on paper. Overall, she is awesome.

Lectures nonstop with no class discussion. Outdated readings with little to no diverse perspectives. Bans papers on topics like racism/abortion but allowed importance of religion papers. Often changes assignment directions after giving them. Way too much work for a 100-level course. Don't reccomend if you want an engaging/inclusive class.

There was a lot of group work which was unfortunate. However she basically lets you redo your paper if you don't like your grade. She is so sweet and understanding. I hate writing and this was by far my best class.

She is a little hard to understand but Dr. Nair has a passion for ensuring that her students are doing well. She's the kind of prof that will notice if you miss class and make sure you are ok. The kindest most understanding prof I've ever had. (Coming from someone who dislikes English)... She is flexible and lets you correct stuff for half credit.

Professor Nair truly cared about how her students did in her class, and would give comments on any paper you asked her to. Any major writing assignment you did not get above a 90 on she gave the opportunity to correct it for a better grade. She was very accommodating and understanding with the attendance policy, but you had to have a valid reason.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: She says she cares about her students but sets up her Canvas to be unnavigateble and assigns so many group projects with out giving anytime in class to meet with the group so it all has to be done when you can meet with the group and record your presentation over zoom. The assignments are not clear and the rubrics are spread out in different places
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: One of the best profs.She truly cares about her students,I have never met a professor that cares so much about a student.grade consisted of 3 papers plus a couple of 1-2 pages papers and a group project. Class can sometimes be confusing, but don't be afraid to ask for help, she will always show unconditional support. PLEASE DO TAKE HER IF U WANT A

Super easy grader, very helpful and genuinely wants you to improve. Attendance is mandatory but she usually just lets us work on our papers in class so she can give feedback. So sweet but kind of disorganized, definitely ask questions to clarify on project requirements.

I hated writing going in, now I don't hate writing. She is very personable and easy to reach and communicate with. She cares for all her students. The class requires writing 3 papers that total to 60% of the overall grade but that's not her fault, that's just how the class works.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing professor. I truly don't understand the negative reviews. Her class was *exceptionally* easy and assignments never took up much of my time. She was a very generous grader and was always super approachable and caring if I ever had questions. I think the people giving her 1 star are just lazy. Class really didn't require much effort at all
Not a big fan of english courses, but this was by far my favorite english professor. Gives good feedback on papers and also allows you to rewrite your paper for extra points.
I would take another class by her.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a good professor but will have random paper assignments throughout the semester. 3 major writing projects that you can rewrite for half credit and 1 presentation. The readings are not super long but super boring. Attendance is mandatory and part of your grade for the class
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Nair was one of the best professors I had at TAMU. I despise English classes but I enjoyed this class. I always do horribly in English classes but I did very well in the class. She is very helpful and helps you outside of class. She will literally tell you what to fix to get a better grade. She also has corrections for every major paper.

She is very kind and wants to help her students in any way that she can, cares a lot about reading, and the reading she assigned was not bad; some were quite interesting, and I do not like to read. Don't Skip it will hurt you; in the long run, she gives plenty of time to do projects and will make time in class to do them.

Professor Nair by far is one the best professors I've had the pleasure to work with. She's more than accommodating and understanding of circumstances and always tries to work with the students. There's not too much work either, if any, and there are only 3 major writing projects that she allows rewrites for up to a 90. She cares about her students.

Professor Nair is a very nice person. She is very helpful and offers so much assistance throughout the entirety of the course. She gives feedback and good help for every assignment. No exams, 3 papers, one presentation. She is very understandable, reasonable, and flexible about attendance, grades, and deadlines. Definitely recommend taking her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: this professor is not clear when giving instructions for assignments. she also is biased towards students. confusing lectures, gets mad when you do not know answer.
Amazing lectures and very helpful with assignments.
Talks too much and feedback not helpful at all. In her own little world thinking everyone loves English and has time for it.
Useless class, useless prof.
This class is a huge waste of time and the professor is extremely unhelpful and biased. Do not recommend at all.
She is nice. However, she is never clear about assignment guidelines. She shows clear favoritism towards students

Professor Nair is one of the best profs I have had so far. She is vary caring and gives everyone a chance to correct major papers up to an A. The workload isn't too bad, usually a short story or poem or two that you read every week and have to write a short paper only. 3 major papers and a presentation make up most of your grade.

One of the best prof I've ever had. Truly cares for you and wants you to do your best. Also, very understanding of circumstances and is willing to accommodate you. Idk how people are complaining about poor grades when she gives everyone the chance to redo assignments up to a 90%. 3 major projects, a presentation, and weekly writing assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Nair grades with strictness. However, she gives you many chances to work to improve your writing. She will work with you if you had a situation come up. I was sick this smester often and she still worked with me.
Professor Nair is one of the best professors I've had. she is super caring and wants you to succeed. I would highly recommend her. I am enrolled for the next course she is teaching next semester.

Honestly, this class is an entry-level course, I don't understand why she makes it hard for us to get good grades. Her comments are not at all specified nor constructive. I had to take the course in a semester full of major courses and ended up working more hours for this course than two 4-credit classes of my major. Don't advise taking her at all.

The class isn't heavy material, I did average work in it. Sometimes I would have time and excel in assignments, she started noting that and marking me below average grades for no reason, when I asked she'd say that I obviously can do better but "I'm choosing not to" when I really didn't have enough time. I had to fight for my grades multiple times.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: The professor is obscenely biased in her grading, she would grade me below average because she thinks "I could do better but my performance is fluctuant". The only reason I managed an A was by sweet-talking her and tending to her ridiculous excuses for grading me low grades, then she edited my grades.

Dr. Nair;s lectures are awesome. She is kind and understanding and helped me with my writing . Take her if you want to improve as a writer. This class is not a blow off class. if you work hard you will succeed.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is an amazing teacher and is extremely kind. I had to ask her questions and she provided help which made me a better writer.

I don't understand how this professor had a 4.7/5 rating here, I was completely deceived by the rating and took a class with her. I took an ENGL 104 class with her, and I kid you not, she continuously fails to achieve anything with the students. Always skips grading assignments. Always grades depending on her mood. Her comment are ridiculously.....

TAKE HER FOR ENGLISH! She is so sweet and so kind. All you have to do is try just a little. You have to write a paper once a week (2 pages max double spaced) over some readings you have to do outside of class (never longer than 2 or 3 pages) as well as 3 big papers that you have a long time to do. No exams! She wants everyone to get A's! TAKE HER!

She is a easy professor and she is very fair. You do have to read poems but they are not very long and I am not a reader and I have never been good at English but this being my first semester in college she was my favorite teacher and made me enjoy college English !! TAKE HER !

She is a very harsh grader. So the first couple essays are difficult. If you go into office hours, you will see she is a very nice person. If you keep asking questions, she sees you are interested. She is interested in hard work and answering the prompt. The prompt is sometimes confusing. So asking is very important to clarify. She is caring.

Dr. Nair has been my favorite professor up to this point. She is a kindhearted person who genuinely cares about you as a person and as a student. If you try and give the class effort and show her that you are trying you will do well.

Always goes off topic during lectures which causes lots of confusion for assignments and reports. Class was okay at first, but then towards the end it felt like a lot of busy work and was just a repetition of the same proposal. Also very picky with work and was extremely critical.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Nair does a lot of talking, but if you engage it'll make class more enjoyable. She takes attendance every day. She cares more about you than an assignment and will work with you if a situation comes up in your life. Make sure you check ecampus, and the instructions for each writing project. Pay attention to everything she says.
